license.file_specific_notice: No separate copyright or license notice appears in the Cross Section node or fragment shader headers.

source.source_oracle: pinned node, fragment shader and helper shaders

mask_alpha_only.role: preserved authored metadata; ignored by this node path

attribute_color_depth.role: Default 0; source calls attribute_surface_depth(), but surface_verify ignores the stored value; native output is fixed RGBA8 for all values.

native_profile.array_controls: Scalar Axis and Mode use source Always clamp with RawCount=2, yielding [0,1]. Array getter values bypass widget clamping. Native profile requires integral Axis and Mode values in [0,1] and explicitly refuses fractional or unsupported values; GameMaker runner behavior for fractional array values remains unresolved.
native_profile.base_sampling: For RGBA source surfaces, follow the axis-selected cross-section line at the authored position. For R8/R16/R32 base input, __channel_pre selects the matching channel helper and performs full-UV grayscale passthrough into RGB with alpha one.
native_profile.anti_aliasing: false uses nearest sampling; true uses bilinear sampling for the base cross-section sample.

modes.BW (0): Compute luminance from RGB using 0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722, multiply by input alpha, invert, mix the raw Level endpoints, then step against the axis-oriented coordinate. Output grayscale with alpha one.
modes.Colored (1): Pass through the sampled RGBA color. When To Alpha is true, replace output alpha with the computed step result.

native_profile.mask: Applied after the initial RGBA8 base output quantization. Sample Mask with nearest filtering, compute (r+g+b)/3 * alpha, and multiply the already-quantized base alpha by that value before writing the result. For an R-channel mask, native uses OpenGL-style (r,0,0,1) sampling, which is a profile choice and not observed source-runner backend behavior. mask_alpha_only remains preserved but ignored.

work_and_bytes.unit: cumulative estimated work units for selected processor rows
work_and_bytes.accounting: Conservative CPU bound covers preflight validation, requote and output write, up to four base-texture taps for bilinear sampling, and one mask tap when present.
work_and_bytes.byte_admission: Quote all selected rows and their RGBA8 output bytes against AvailableBytes before allocation or row observation.

limitations: GPU shader arithmetic, licensed runtime behavior, and live Studio behavior remain unverified.
Fractional Axis and Mode values are explicitly refused by the native profile; source shader uniform conversion for fractional values is unverified.
Fractional source-runner boolean conversion is unverified; native numeric boolean profile uses finite value not equal to zero.
The native R-mask profile uses OpenGL-style (r,0,0,1) channel swizzling; licensed backend behavior is unverified.
Physical Atlas inputs and attribute_process=false outer arrays are unsupported.
native_profile.boolean_controls: The native profile accepts boolean values and finite numeric controls through a finite-nonzero truth conversion. GameMaker fractional boolean conversion behavior is unresolved; no float-cast truth behavior is claimed.
native_profile.blend: Assumes the default normal blend entry state used by the node draw path.

supported_domain.coverage: All source controls; axis and mode; nearest/bilinear base sampling; BW/Colored and To Alpha; raw and reversed level ranges; masks, R-channel helpers, quantization; native and PXC persistence; array row processing; bounded admission and refusal.
supported_domain.limitations: Atlas and attribute_process=false outer arrays unsupported; fractional Axis/Mode and source-runner numeric boolean conversions do not claim runtime parity.
